scope: All Paraguayan / Paraguayan-relevant datasets available for Iván's thesis. For P1/P2/P3 data needs.

huggingface_datasets.name: somosnlp-hackathon-2026/paraguay-cultural-alignment
huggingface_datasets.description: Spanish (Paraguayan) cultural alignment dataset with 4-block pattern ([inicio]→[base]→[link]→[cultural]). SFT + DPO configs. Built by LATAM SomosNLP hackathon team. Source: thinkPy/ultrachat-es-30k-topics + thinkPy/corpus-cultura-paraguaya.

huggingface_datasets.name: thinkPy/ultrachat-es-30k-topics
huggingface_datasets.description: Spanish conversations with topics + scores. Source for Paraguay cultural alignment dataset.

huggingface_datasets.name: thinkPy/corpus-cultura-paraguaya
huggingface_datasets.description: Corpus of reference for Paraguayan culture. Provides [cultural] blocks.

huggingface_datasets.name: datasets (search='paraguay' on HF)
huggingface_datasets.description: Search for 'paraguay' returns 8 datasets. Names need to be extracted individually via web_extract. Likely includes Paraguayan news, weather, and possibly the cultural-alignment one shown above.

huggingface_datasets.name: datasets (search='jopara' on HF)
huggingface_datasets.description: 4 datasets found. Names not extracted; need individual page fetch.

huggingface_datasets.name: datasets (search='guarani' on HF)
huggingface_datasets.description: 38 datasets found. Mostly ASR (speech recognition) for Guarani. Filter to Spanish/Jopara mixed content only.

zenodo_datasets.name: Diverse datasets for Paraguay
data_included: Weekly crime for the 5 largest cities
Daily weather data for the 5 largest cities
Temperature and holiday data for the 5 largest cities
zenodo_datasets.description: Comprehensive Paraguayan context dataset. Excellent for P3 (socio-economic context for depression) and P1 (urban overlays).

paraguayan_government_datasets.data: Monthly electricity consumption stats, demand by region, distribution losses
Population census, EPH (Encuesta Permanente de Hogares), household surveys
Census, PND (Plan Nacional de Desarrollo), SDH (Sistema de Datos por Hogar)
PRONII researcher registry, Fondecyt grant projects, scientific publications

paraguayan_government_datasets.agency: MADES (Ministerio del Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible)

geospatial_datasets.name: Geofabrik Paraguay OSM Extract
geospatial_datasets.description: OpenStreetMap Paraguay raw extract. Polygons, building footprints, roads, addresses.
geospatial_datasets.p_relevance_explanation: Direct cartographic baselayer for P1. Cited by Cristaldo's CIDi FADA work.

geospatial_datasets.name: paraguay-geodata (Iván's existing asset)
geospatial_datasets.description: Paraguayan geospatial data already in repo
